topics.title: eCMRs
topics.subtitle: Change Management Requests: create, track and close a CMR on one form.
topics.summary: Create, track and close a Change Management Request (CMR) on one form.

blocks.text: Use this form to create, track and close a Change Management Request (CMR): a request to change a part, drawing, process, tooling, material or documentation. One CMR record holds everything from the request through Quality and Engineering review to Implementation and closing.

eCMRs replaces the **Create Change Request**, **Change Request Management** and **QC CMRs** forms. It is an Enflite form on its own table and IDO (ue_ecmrs); standard SyteLine forms and data are not changed.

items: Click **New**. The form fills in **CMR Num** (CMR-YYMMDD-HHMMSS), **Create Date** and **Created By**.
Fill in the top of the form: PO, **Item**, **Vendor**, **Priority** and the **Requested Action**.
Under Change Request Fields, pick the **Dept**, **Work Center** and **Initial Change**. The **Requirement checkboxes** are ticked for you; change them if needed.
Quality and Engineering fill in their sections: codes, disposition, reviewer and RCA notes.
**Planning**, **Purchasing** and **CM** tick their box when their part is done and pick a reviewer.
Select **Closed** to close the CMR. Save after each step.

topics.title: Status
topics.subtitle: Field on the eCMRs form
topics.summary: The stage the CMR is at. Change it as the CMR moves from one team to the next.

blocks.text: The stage the CMR is at. Change it as the CMR moves from one team to the next.
The stage of the CMR's workflow, which also says which team has it:

head: Status
Means
rows: The CMR is being entered: the request, item and Initial Change (QA-300-037 5.5.1-5.5.4).
With Engineering, to review the issue and decide the solution (5.5.5-5.5.7).
With Quality: after Engineering's review, and after each Implementation step (5.5.7, 5.5.9.4).
With Planning, to communicate the change to the floor (5.5.9.1).
With Purchasing, for a Supplier Deviation Request: documents go to the supplier (5.5.9.2).
With Configuration Management, to release an NEI or ECO into the Drawing Books (5.5.9.3).
All reviews done and the CMR closed (5.5.10).

items: Data Input, QC Approval, Eng Review, Planning, Purchasing, CM, Complete
Pick the stage the CMR is moving to.

blocks.text: From [QA-300-037](/syteline/procedures/qa-300-037) (Change Management, Rev B draft), section 5.5:

items: **5.5.7** Engineering sets **QC Approval** when their review is done and reassigns the CMR to Quality.
**5.5.9.4** After each Implementation step the CMR goes back to Quality with **QC Approval**.
**5.5.10** When all reviews are done and **Closed** is ticked, set **Complete**.
The list in eCMRs is its own list of 7 stages; it isn't the status list of the old QC CMRs form.
Changing the status doesn't notify anyone. Use **Notify** to email the person in **Assigned**.

**5.5.7** Engineering reassigns it to Quality when done.

topics.summary: The CMR's unique number, in the form **CMR-YYMMDD-HHMMSS**: the date and time **New** was clicked (for example CMR-260929-111742).

blocks.text: The CMR's unique number, in the form **CMR-YYMMDD-HHMMSS**: the date and time **New** was clicked (for example CMR-260929-111742).

A **CMR** is a Change Management Request: the record used to manage deviations, clarifications and process gaps found by vendors, customers and Enflite staff (QA-300-037). **CMR Num** identifies one CMR; use it on build records and in emails.

items: Click **New**. The number appears straight away.

**5.5.3** Save the form and record the CMR number.
**5.5.6** Enter the CMR number in the Notes section of the Build Record, for traceability.

head: Value
Means
rows: The parts are accepted as they are (use as is) and can go to stock.

No fault found: nothing wrong was found.
The parts are rejected, for example returned to the vendor (RTV).
The parts are reworked to meet the drawing.

blocks.text: Planning's part of the change: communicating it to the floor.

Planning's implementation step: passing the change (documents or information) to the production floor (QA-300-037 5.5.9.1). The checkbox means that step is done, or not needed; **Reviewer ID** is who did it.

items: Checkbox, Reviewer ID (drop-down) and a name box
Employees: number, name and user name
Distribute the documentation or information to the floor.
Tick the checkbox, and pick yourself in **Reviewer ID**; the name fills in.
Set **Status** to QC Approval and **Assigned** to the Quality reviewer, save, then click **Notify**.

blocks.text: From [QA-300-037](/syteline/procedures/qa-300-037) (Change Management, Rev B draft), section 5.5:

items: **5.5.9.1** Planning, if communication is required to the floor.
**5.5.9.4** After completion, select the check box and yourself as Reviewer ID, reassign to Quality and click Notify.
**5.5.9.5** If Planning isn't required, tick the check box anyway to show it's complete.

topics.title: CM
topics.subtitle: Field on the eCMRs form
topics.summary: Configuration Management's part of the change: releasing an NEI or ECO into the Drawing Books.

blocks.text: Configuration Management's part of the change: releasing an NEI or ECO into the Drawing Books.
**CM** is Configuration Management: keeping drawings and their revisions controlled. Its step is releasing an NEI or ECO into the Drawing Books (5.5.9.3). The checkbox means it's done, or not needed.

items: Checkbox, Reviewer ID (drop-down) and a name box
Employees: number, name and user name
Release the NEI or ECO into the Drawing Books.
Tick the checkbox, and pick yourself in **Reviewer ID**; the name fills in.
Set **Status** to QC Approval and **Assigned** to the Quality reviewer, save, then click **Notify**.

blocks.text: From [QA-300-037](/syteline/procedures/qa-300-037) (Change Management, Rev B draft), section 5.5:

items: **5.5.9.3** CM, if an NEI or ECO was generated: the CMR is reassigned to Configuration Management and released into Drawing Books.
**5.5.9.4** After completion, select the check box and yourself as Reviewer ID, reassign to Quality and click Notify.
**5.5.9.5** If CM isn't required, tick the check box anyway to show it's complete.

topics.title: Closed
topics.subtitle: Field on the eCMRs form
topics.summary: Closes the CMR. Clear it to reopen the CMR.

blocks.text: Closes the CMR. Clear it to reopen the CMR.
The CMR is finished: every review and implementation step is done (QA-300-037 5.5.10).

items: By you, when all reviews are done
Tick **Closed**. **Close Date** (today) and **Closed By** (you) fill in.

blocks.text: From [QA-300-037](/syteline/procedures/qa-300-037) (Change Management, Rev B draft), section 5.5:

items: **5.5.10** After all reviews are complete, check Closed and change status to Complete. This completes the CMR process.
Closed CMRs sort after open ones in the list.
It doesn't check the Requirement or Implementation boxes first; make sure every review is done.

topics.title: eCMRs glossary
topics.subtitle: Terms, abbreviations and codes used on the eCMRs form
topics.summary: What the terms and abbreviations on the eCMRs form and in its procedures mean.

blocks.text: Terms and abbreviations used on the eCMRs form and in the procedures that use it. Where a term comes from a procedure, the procedure is named.

head: Term
Meaning
rows: Change Management Request: the eCMRs record used to manage deviations, clarifications and process gaps found by vendors, customers and Enflite staff. (QA-300-037)
Material Review Report: the SyteLine form for nonconforming, suspected or damaged material, including its review and disposition. (QA-300-037)
Topic Review Request: the SyteLine form for errors by Enflite production staff. (QA-300-037)
An issue that needs no detailed rework instructions or Engineering Disposition to return to type design (for example a loose screw or missing washer); handled as a TRR. (QA-300-037)
Supplier Deviation Request: a supplier's request to accept parts that depart from the drawing, specification or PO. (QA-300-003)
Engineering Change Order: explains changes to manufacturing documents. (QA-300-037)
Notice of Engineering Intent: a minor change to a drawing, for clarity or to address a discrepancy. (QA-300-037)
Temporary Solution: a minor temporary change to specific articles, with valid acceptance. (QA-300-037)
Configuration Management: control of drawings and their revisions; releases NEIs and ECOs into the Drawing Books.
The decision on what to do with affected parts: accept (use as is), hold, rework, scrap, reject / return to vendor.
Return to vendor: rejected parts sent back to the supplier.
Root cause analysis: finding why a problem happened.
Request for quotation: a request to suppliers for a price quote.
Purchase order: Enflite's order to a supplier. A PO line is one item on it.
Sarbanes-Oxley Act: US law on controls over financial reporting.
A SyteLine production order to make a quantity of an item.
A SyteLine production area or machine group where job operations are done.
A batch of a lot-tracked item / one unit of a serial-tracked item.
Infor Document Management, where supporting documents are attached to the CMR record.

blocks.text: The Reason and Cause codes are explained on the [Reason Code](/syteline/ecmrs/fields/reason_code) and [Cause Code](/syteline/ecmrs/fields/cause_code) pages; the disposition values on [QC Disposition](/syteline/ecmrs/fields/qc_disposition).
